selection_rule: Prefer public longitudinal measurements with separable chips or experiments, a scientifically meaningful early-to-final endpoint, and honest group-held-out evaluation.

candidates.name: Lung-on-chip tuberculosis bacterial growth
candidates.size_and_structure: Approximately 27 GB growth-rate archive containing TIFF stacks, CSV, and MATLAB artifacts.
candidates.cadence_duration_endpoint: Longitudinal bacterial growth is scientifically relevant, but stable chip IDs, experimental groups, and a predefined terminal endpoint require full archive/paper reconstruction.
candidates.decision: defer; do not manufacture independence from image stacks

candidates.name: Bright-field organ-on-chip image quality dataset
candidates.license: Zenodo metadata says CC-BY-4.0; associated article text should be reconciled before redistribution
candidates.size_and_structure: 3,072 unique images across 58 date prefixes; datasheet has cell type, seeding density, time after seeding, day, good/bad decision, and flow rate.
candidates.independent_experiments: date prefixes are acquisition batches, not validated biological experiment IDs
candidates.cadence_duration_endpoint: Only 828 rows have a non-missing time-after-seeding value (0, 1, or 2 h); the good/bad label is per image rather than a linked final chip endpoint.
candidates.group_evaluation_possible: no, not without inventing unit linkage
candidates.ingestion_effort: low for metadata, high and scientifically unjustified for longitudinal reconstruction
candidates.expected_usefulness: useful for image-quality classification, not this stopping question

candidates.name: Organ-on-chip electrochemical impedance spectroscopy
candidates.size_and_structure: 90 sequential spectra named CRU006-Device1-01 through CRU006-Device1-90 plus derived reports.
candidates.cadence_duration_endpoint: Sequential measurements exist, but no independent-chip final biological endpoint is supplied.

candidates.name: OCT flowmetry for vessel-on-chip
candidates.size_and_structure: Four raw OCT scans of roughly 1.64 GB each.
candidates.chips: single setup not documented as independent biological chips
candidates.cadence_duration_endpoint: Flow scans without a linked terminal biological endpoint.
candidates.expected_usefulness: flow measurement validation, not early endpoint stopping

conclusion: No audited direct organ-on-chip dataset currently supports a defensible group-held-out early-to-final stopping experiment. The tuberculosis dataset is the only plausible next candidate, but it must first establish chip identity, independent experimental groups, and a terminal endpoint. Direct OoC evidence is therefore a documented negative result for Phase 2, not a positive validation claim.
